description: First-party task-class routing verdicts backed by committed receipts in public/research/arena-receipts/*.json. Enforced by scripts/check-intelligence-freshness.mjs.

verdicts.rationale: Passed 5/5 tasks in Round 6 at $2.00/$10.00 per 1M tokens ($0.10/1M cached input through 2026-11-30) with sub-2.4s latency across TypeScript row normalization, WCAG AA dark-mode UI synthesis, and Langfuse telemetry wiring.
verdicts.named_weakness: Requires thinking=high on subtle specification/governance pushback prompts; at thinking=low it prioritizes speed over critique.

verdicts.rationale: Held 7/7 constraint stacks across Rounds 1, 3, 4, 5, and 6 while closing the Round 2 governance pushback gap.
verdicts.named_weakness: $10/$50 per 1M token pricing is 5x higher than Gemini 4 Argon and Claude Sonnet 5 on routine coding tasks.

verdicts.task_class: Architectural review, policy pushback & ambiguous specs
verdicts.rationale: Consistently flags self-contradictory specifications, provenance violations, and canon-lock boundaries without requiring manual thinking-level overrides.
verdicts.named_weakness: Higher latency (3.1s–4.8s) and $5/$25 pricing make it overkill for saturated single-file coding.

verdicts.task_class: Balanced production coding & MCP tool loops
verdicts.rationale: Passed 5/5 tasks in Round 6 at $2.00/$10.00 per 1M tokens with 128K synchronous output and tight Claude Code / MCP integration.
verdicts.named_weakness: Text/vision/code only (no native audio or video input); cached input ($0.20/M) is 2x Argon's introductory cached rate ($0.10/M).

verdicts.rationale: Matched frontier tiers on standard TypeScript validation in Round 3 at <10% of flagship token cost.
